# Ranch House Restaurant

> Breakfast Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Biscuits and gravy, waffles, benedicts and burritos on West Hillsborough Avenue, from a family-style kitchen guests say fills everyone up.

- Phone: (813) 884-1220
- Address: 7706 W Hillsborough Ave, Tampa, FL 33615
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country, Gibsonton
- Offers: Benedicts and breakfast plates; Biscuits and gravy; Waffles, pancakes and French toast
- Rating: 4.3 from 678 Google reviews
